reasoning: 驗證目標：HU 判定 amplifier 存在、且使用者選擇改變 speed controlled volume 之 level 時，HU 改變顯示並於 <Tsend> 內以 $VolumeSCV$ 送出改變後之值（CFTS022-4915175）。為什麼一條 TC：兩個結果同屬一個觸發之後續（§5.7），配多行 ER。與 -009 之區辨：本條為使用者調整側之 amp present 分支；**本條之 outcome 無「改變 level」亦無「存入記憶體」**，與 -009 不同，照條文原樣寫不得反向補入 —— 這與 -007（AMP 存在時 HU 不改變 level）一致。<Tsend> 於條文內未定義具體值，依 §8.4.1 保留原符號，不填任何時間值。AMP 存在與否之建立方式：VF651_V6_R2（HDCC28 版 e20ba7a4…）之 PROXI Parameters 一節列有 `Acustic_Configuration` 與 `Audio_System_Type` 兩個參數名，但同節明文：「The characteristics of the "PROXI" Parameters and their related values are defined in the "PROXI requirements" specific for the vehicle project」—— **值不在該文件內**，而該 PROXI requirements 不在 inputs/。依 §8.4.1 不自行填任何參數值；Pre-Condition 以條文自身之措辭（amp present / not present）表述，此為 profile §3.2 明列之合法 spec-trigger。VF651 未列為 specification_reference —— 需求來源為 CFTS022，VF651 只用於背景理解。　【R35-3】條文之觸發含「the HU has determined that the amplifier is present」——**HU 之內部判定環節**。本 TC 之 Pre-Condition **只設定客觀組態**（amplifier 存在與否），不斷言 HU 之內部狀態。理由是方向而非等同：「HU 已判定」是 HU 自客觀組態導出之內部狀態，測試者無法直接設定，亦無規格指定之可觀察指標；**以客觀組態為起點時，判定環節一併納入受測範圍**—— HU 若判定錯誤，本 TC 即 fail，而那正是應被偵測的失效。此為保守方向（多測而非少測），符合不對稱錯誤代價原則。**PC 禁止寫「The HU has determined…」**，那是對不可觀察內部狀態之斷言。本處置可逆：若日後裁定判定環節須獨立驗證，本 TC 只需擴充中間步驟，不需重寫。已列 RD-1 #13 詢問上游是否有規格指定之可觀察指標。

distinguishing_axis.delta: -010 為使用者調整側之 amp present 分支（改顯示＋送訊號）；-009 為 not present 分支

tcs.tc_title: HU changes the display and sends $VolumeSCV$ within <Tsend> when the customer changes the speed controlled volume with the amplifier present
tcs.test_item: When the HU has determined that the amplifier is present and the customer selects to change the level of the speed controlled volume, the HU shall change the display and send the $VolumeSCV$ signal with the changed value within <Tsend>
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. An external amplifier is present on the vehicle
2. The speed controlled volume personalization entry is displayed on the HU
3. A CAN interface tool is connected
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Start the CAN trace
2. Read the level of the speed controlled volume displayed on the HU
3. Select a level of the speed controlled volume other than the one read in step 2
4. Read the level of the speed controlled volume displayed on the HU
5. Read the first $VolumeSCV$ signal in the CAN trace after the selection and its timestamp relative to the selection
tcs.expected_result:
1. The CAN trace is running
2. The level of the speed controlled volume is read
3. The level selected in step 3 is applied
4. The HU displays the level selected in step 3
5. The $VolumeSCV$ signal carries the level selected in step 3 and is sent within <Tsend> of the selection
